first_3_seconds: Faded red dentside Ford dump truck heaped with dirt far over the cab roof, backing out of a dirt pile with a grinning driver in a hard hat at the window
spoken_or_text_hook: Text: "Randy is quite the dump truck operator" (no speech)
why_it_went_viral: An absurdly overloaded old work truck plus a named guy and a dry one-line caption; it is a sight gag anyone gets in one second, which is why it pulled 48x the account median. Share rate is low (0.22%), so it spread on watch and likes more than sends.
who_shares_it_and_to_whom: Guys who work dirt or farm, to the coworker who always overloads the truck
shape_jacob_can_borrow_alone: One continuous shot of a truck doing something visibly ridiculous at work, with a single deadpan caption naming the culprit.

first_3_seconds: Low handheld glide along the bed of a lifted blue and cream 1977 Ford highboy on big tires, parked in a metal carport
spoken_or_text_hook: Text: "Anyone want to buy it?" (no speech)
why_it_went_viral: A clean two-tone highboy is a dream truck for this crowd and the for-sale question turns every viewer into a buyer or a tagger. 1.23% shares on 846k views is the 'look what is for sale' send.
who_shares_it_and_to_whom: Dentside fans to the buddy or spouse they would need permission from
shape_jacob_can_borrow_alone: Slow 15 second walkaround of one truck with a single question on screen that invites a yes or a tag.

first_3_seconds: Camera walks down a line of two-tone dentside Fords parked on leaves, starting on a blue and light blue one and swinging to a maroon one
spoken_or_text_hook: Text: "Take your pick" (old-time country song under it)
why_it_went_viral: A row of five or six trucks and a forced choice; people answer in comments and send it to argue the pick. 1.85% shares and 28x median show the choose-one prompt doing the work.
who_shares_it_and_to_whom: Classic Ford guys to the friend they argue trucks with
shape_jacob_can_borrow_alone: Walk past several trucks or parts in one take and ask the viewer to pick one.

first_3_seconds: Tight low sweep from the tailgate up the side of a glossy black lifted 1979 Ford with chrome trim, inside a lit shop
spoken_or_text_hook: No on-screen text; song lyric "Men would search for wealth untold" (caption: Something about black and chrome)
why_it_went_viral: Pure eye candy: mirror black paint, chrome and swampers shot close and smooth with a nostalgic country song. Nothing to explain, just a truck people want, and 1.25% sent it.
who_shares_it_and_to_whom: Dentside owners to the friend building one, as a 'this is the goal' send
shape_jacob_can_borrow_alone: Close, slow, low-angle orbit of a freshly cleaned truck set to one old country song, no talking.

first_3_seconds: Very close slide along a maroon and silver bed side to a huge swamper tire, in a showroom with other trucks behind
spoken_or_text_hook: No text; George Strait "Ocean Front Property" playing
why_it_went_viral: Same recipe as his other hits: rare color combo, big tires, tight detail shots and a classic country track, then a reveal of more trucks in the room. 1.64% shares at 27x median.
who_shares_it_and_to_whom: Older Ford fans to a brother or dad who had one that color
shape_jacob_can_borrow_alone: Start on a tight detail, pull back to reveal the whole truck and then the room it sits in.

first_3_seconds: Walk up to a black lifted 1978 Ford on grass with a golden retriever trotting past, hand reaches for the door handle
spoken_or_text_hook: No text; song lyric "like I'm a prisoner of the highway"
why_it_went_viral: First-person 'get in and start it' sequence: door opens on a mint red interior, key turns, gauges come alive. Viewers stay for the start-up payoff, though shares were low (0.19%) so it grew on watch time and likes.
who_shares_it_and_to_whom: Men who grew up riding in one, to a dad or brother (weakly; this one is watched more than sent)
shape_jacob_can_borrow_alone: Point of view walk-up, open the door, sit, turn the key, end on the gauges.

first_3_seconds: Static shot past a giant tractor tire at a black lifted 1972 Ford in a gravel lot; the truck starts to pull away
spoken_or_text_hook: Text: "What do you think think about this '72 powerstroke?" (typo in original; no speech)
why_it_went_viral: A diesel swapped into a 1972 body is a built-in argument, and the question hands people the comment. Nine seconds long so it loops; shares modest at 0.41%.
who_shares_it_and_to_whom: Powerstroke and classic Ford guys to the purist friend who will hate it
shape_jacob_can_borrow_alone: One short static shot of an unusual engine and body combination driving off, with an opinion question on screen.

first_3_seconds: High angle pan across a building packed with old Fords: a red OBS in front, a patina teal one, green, cream and two-tone trucks behind
spoken_or_text_hook: No text; song lyric "I just spent my last night" (caption: Some variety in here!)
why_it_went_viral: The collection reveal: a room full of trucks from every generation, each viewer hunting for their own. Best share rate in the set for this account (2.74%).
who_shares_it_and_to_whom: Truck guys to friends with 'imagine having this barn'
shape_jacob_can_borrow_alone: One slow pan across everything you have in the shop or yard, from above if possible.

first_3_seconds: Fast pan from a blue dentside to a cream and brown one to a bright blue shortbed inside the Ford-sign showroom
spoken_or_text_hook: No text; song lyric about a phone ringing
why_it_went_viral: Eleven seconds, three trucks, quick whip pans, loops easily. Same 'which one' pull as the collection clip with 2.51% shares.
who_shares_it_and_to_whom: Dentside fans to the buddy who shares their taste
shape_jacob_can_borrow_alone: Very short clip that whips between two or three vehicles, built to loop.

first_3_seconds: Red lifted Ford highboy on a wooden trailer deck; camera drops along the rocker and tilts up under the truck at headers and exhaust
spoken_or_text_hook: No text; song lyric "You said you hate the smell of cigarette smoke" (caption says fresh 460, 4 speed, for sale soon)
why_it_went_viral: Shows the part most videos skip: a spotless underside with headers and red shocks on a nearly finished build, plus 'for sale soon' in the caption. Shares 0.57%, so interest was mostly watch and comment.
who_shares_it_and_to_whom: Builders to a friend mid-project, as a standard to hit
shape_jacob_can_borrow_alone: Walkaround that goes under the truck or behind a panel to show the work nobody normally films.

first_3_seconds: Wide tripod shot at sunset of a lifted two-tone blue and white OBS F-150 parked beside towering hay stacks, small in frame
spoken_or_text_hook: Audio clip of the Grave Digger origin story: "And he badmouthed me in front of a bunch of employees..."
why_it_went_viral: A well known monster truck story clip laid over calm, pretty shots of an old mud-tire Ford; the audio is the hook and the truck fits the 'old junk' line. 146x the account median with 0.8% shares, so the borrowed story carried it.
who_shares_it_and_to_whom: Monster truck and OBS fans to buddies who know the Grave Digger story
shape_jacob_can_borrow_alone: Lay a short spoken story (your own voice) over four or five locked-off beauty shots of the truck.

first_3_seconds: Night shot of the lifted OBS with one front tire climbed up on a parking lot curb, axle flexed, cab lights on
spoken_or_text_hook: Audio: "Wow, Kristie. Do you see that truck? ... That is so tacky. That must be one of those rednecks I've heard about."
why_it_went_viral: Self-deprecating: he plays the snobby voice that judges his truck and answers with the truck flexing and rolling down the road. Owners of loud lifted trucks see themselves, and 1.4% sent it at 106x median.
who_shares_it_and_to_whom: Lifted truck owners to each other and to the wife or friend who calls the truck tacky
shape_jacob_can_borrow_alone: Quote what critics say about your truck, then answer with nothing but footage of the truck being exactly that.

first_3_seconds: Same sunset hay stack location, wide shot of the OBS side-on, cuts to it framed between two hay walls
spoken_or_text_hook: No text; rap song lyric "I guess it was meant to be" (caption: Thoughts on the 14 wides?)
why_it_went_viral: Good light, a striking location and a single opinion question in the caption about a divisive tire choice. 98x median but only 0.7% shares, so comments and rewatch drove it.
who_shares_it_and_to_whom: OBS guys to the friend deciding on tires
shape_jacob_can_borrow_alone: Three or four still tripod shots at golden hour with one opinion question about a single part.

first_3_seconds: Rear view of the OBS on wet pavement reflecting the sky, big swampers, quoted text at top
spoken_or_text_hook: Text: "Bro why would you get swampers they ride like sht" then "..." over a roller of the truck (audio is a borrowed TV-style voice clip)
why_it_went_viral: Answers a real complaint with no defense at all: quote the critic, then just show the truck rolling on the tires looking great. Every mud tire owner has heard the line. Highest share rate for this account in the set (2.58%).
who_shares_it_and_to_whom: Guys on swampers or mud tires to the buddy who gives them grief for the ride
shape_jacob_can_borrow_alone: Put the criticism on screen as a quote, then cut to a wordless shot of the truck that is the whole answer.

first_3_seconds: Locked-off silhouette of the OBS on a road against a blazing orange sunset over a green field
spoken_or_text_hook: No text; song lyric "started with hello darling" (caption: First and second clip)
why_it_went_viral: Just very good pictures: three sunset compositions of the same truck with a slow song. The caption nudges a rewatch to compare clips; 0.94% shares.
who_shares_it_and_to_whom: Truck people to a friend as a wallpaper-type send
shape_jacob_can_borrow_alone: Three locked-off sunset shots of the truck, ask which clip is best.

first_3_seconds: Foggy frosted hillside, OBS small in frame with lights on, then a close low shot of the front tire and brush guard
spoken_or_text_hook: Audio: "I absolutely hated it. I thought it was the most grandpa farm-looking truck ever..." (caption: Brushgaurd?)
why_it_went_viral: Uses a borrowed 'I hated it at first' voice clip to frame a new brush guard, then asks for a verdict. A relatable change-of-mind beat on one part; 1.12% shares at 65x median.
who_shares_it_and_to_whom: OBS owners to friends debating the same add-on
shape_jacob_can_borrow_alone: Admit you hated a part or look at first, show it on the truck, ask for the verdict.

first_3_seconds: Near-black frame, truck lit only by its own cab lights and headlights, lightning flashing purple behind it
spoken_or_text_hook: No speech, no text
why_it_went_viral: Lightning behind a lit-up lifted truck is a rare shot and the storm does all the work in 14 seconds. 50x median, 1.0% shares; mostly a 'look at this' clip.
who_shares_it_and_to_whom: Truck and storm people to friends, as a cool shot
shape_jacob_can_borrow_alone: Park the truck in unusual weather or light and film one locked-off shot with only its own lights on.

first_3_seconds: Bright day, OBS driving slowly toward camera on a gravel road between wheat fields under big clouds
spoken_or_text_hook: Text and audio: "How many mpg does that thing get?" ... "0.8" at the gas pump ... "Well that's not economical at all" ... "Nope!"
why_it_went_viral: The single most asked question of any lifted gas truck, answered with a joke number and a cut to the pump, in nine seconds. Everyone with a thirsty truck relates; 0.72% shares.
who_shares_it_and_to_whom: Gas truck owners to whoever keeps asking about their mileage
shape_jacob_can_borrow_alone: Put the question you get asked most on screen, answer with one cutaway shot and a one-word reply.

first_3_seconds: Close side shot of the front fender and huge tire at dusk, pink horizon behind
spoken_or_text_hook: Song lyric as caption and audio: "Just an old half ton short bed Ford"
why_it_went_viral: The lyric literally describes the truck, so the song and the picture click, and it taps dad and uncle nostalgia. 41x median, 1.15% shares.
who_shares_it_and_to_whom: Men to their dad or uncle, or anyone who learned to drive in an old Ford
shape_jacob_can_borrow_alone: Pick a song line that literally describes the truck and cut plain detail shots to it.

first_3_seconds: Sunset hay stack wide shot again with text over it
spoken_or_text_hook: Text: "Sure you can look at what I reposted... but if you want to know how I actually feel, look at what I have saved,"
why_it_went_viral: A general trend text pasted over reused truck footage; it has nothing to do with trucks and people did not send it (0.22% shares). Views likely came from the trend and the pretty footage. Weakest model of the ten.
who_shares_it_and_to_whom: Unclear; few people shared it
shape_jacob_can_borrow_alone: Not much to borrow; if anything, a personal one-line thought over still truck shots.
